_comment: Per-game_code presentation fields that have no reliable official-metadata source and so cannot be safely auto-derived: a site URL path segment (renaming it would break live links) and the stage-state snapshot filename. Round-count/stage list is included explicitly too, since it is not currently a clean function of final_round_number (see tournament_context.py docstring) -- deriving it from a formula risked silently disagreeing with what the live site actually serves. venue/holes/format are sourced from the official getGameList response (see candidate/website-v2/data/next_event.json for the shape/provenance this was copied from) -- they are metadata-derived data, not invented, just not yet plumbed through scripts/01's collector into tournament_master. hub_card is scripts/86's HOME tournament-hub card content (see its _hub_card_comment) -- entries are listed in the order their cards should render on HOME.

2026080001._comment: KG Ladies Open -- a completed historical tournament, not currently active (see config/active_tournament.json). Kept here only so its permanently-published site routes (scripts/94's REQUIRED_ROUTES) are derived from this registry like every other tournament's, instead of a separate hardcoded literal list. No artifacts mapping: no script writes new KG Ladies Open artifacts any more.
2026080001._hub_card_comment: Completed tournament: every field here is a fixed historical fact scripts/86 has no other way to derive (no live official-result artifact is fetched for a tournament that is over) -- display_name/status/date_range/result_line/cta_stage, once recorded, never change. nav_stages is the real, already-published set of stage tabs this specific card has always shown.

2026120001._artifacts_comment: Compatibility mapping only -- these are the real, already-committed filenames scripts 83/84/94/96/98/99/100/101 always used for this tournament. Never renamed. A game_code with no entry here (or no entry for a given artifact_type) falls back to TournamentContext.artifact_path()'s generic '<game_code>_<ARTIFACT_TYPE>.json' naming -- see tournament_context.py.
2026120001._hub_card_comment: Active tournament: scripts/86 computes display_name/status/date_range/venue/nav-stage-availability live from TournamentContext + ok_open_available_stages() (real validated state), never from a hardcoded literal -- only nav_stages (which stage tabs this card has always surfaced; R3's own live-evidence page is intentionally not one of them, matching this site's existing PRE-nav convention) needs recording here.
